description: This file defines a composable screen for a quiz app using Jetpack Compose. It displays questions, handles navigation between questions, captures user selections, and calculates the score upon submission.

classes.name: QuestionCard
classes.description: A composable function that renders a question and its choices, allowing selection with visual feedback.

methods.name: QuizScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that manages the quiz flow, including current question index, user selections, and submission logic.

methods.name: QuestionCard
methods.description: Displays a single question and its choices, with choice selection handling.
